_doc: The scripted captain reads the star chart (owner, 2026-11-09: "remove ship names, show only if I hover over it or target it", "add a search box to find ships", "planets should be on the stand not floating above it"): a new Concord campaign's chart with no ship names, the search box with what it finds, then the fleet's sector picked so its name shows. It saves to user://campaign-playtest-concord.json, never over the player's campaign. In a window, snap saves stills into docs/screenshots/game/chart-search/.
